purpose: Appearance textures for the 3D views. Not used by any visibility or metric calculation.

moonColor.grid: simple cylindrical, centred on 0 deg longitude, row 0 north: identical to globe/moon-elevation.json (same UV mapping)
moonColor.conversion: 16-bit sRGB TIFF -> 8-bit sRGB (value / 257, rounded) -> JPEG q90, 4:4:4; 2048 version by Lanczos downsampling. No colour or contrast change.

source.product: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit, 2025 colour map, lroc_color_16bit_srgb_4k.tif (from LRO LROC WAC mosaics)
source.credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio; LRO LROC team (Arizona State University)

moonColor.note: A colour-enhanced albedo map without shadows, designed for rendering. Lighting must come from the true Sun direction.

earthColor.conversion: PNG 5400x2700 -> Lanczos 2048x1024 -> JPEG q90, 4:4:4. No colour change.

source.product: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation, March 2004 monthly composite (world.topo.2004-03)
source.credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center; Blue Marble data courtesy of Reto Stockli (NASA/GSFC)

earthColor.note: Historical appearance (March 2004). Not 2027 weather or cloud cover. Earth rotation in sky.json is the low-precision IAU_EARTH model, visual only.
